comments.comment:
Locally run the test more 1k times - no any issues after fix.

waiting a Bot Vise.

--> Run :: All: No blockers found!

TeamCity --> Run :: All Results

jooger, my comments:

  1. SqlSystemViewsSelfTest - unused imports
  2. SqlTestFunctions - Thread.sleep() function is not reliable. Thread may be woken up earlier than expected, what will cause flaky failures again. I would rather use busy wait with or (sleep + busy wait) with time checks before and after. If the difference after wake up is smaller than needed, burn some cycles until it is enough.

--> Run :: All: No blockers found!
